title: Pin every precedence step of the attempt-only exact_identity_required project decision with tests
outcome: Pin every precedence step of the attempt-only exact_identity_required project decision with tests
acceptance: Tests in src/tests/delegation_review_access.rs cover: (a) an unstamped legacy record with no custody rows, where consistent native facts alone decide the 400; (b) unreadable custody or a missing auth key, which falls back to the plain 404; (c) a commissioning-stamped record whose parent and child later moved, which still gives 400 to an original-project root and 404 to a root of the new project
Exact-input focused tests and a clean review pair
